newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury 2-year notes seen yielding 6.28 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury 2-year notes seen yielding 6.28 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's auction of $17.25 billion in two-year notes on Wednesday is expected to produce a yield near 6.28 percent, dealers said.
At 1240 EST/1740 GMT, yields on the two-year notes were quoted at 6.270 percent in when-issued trade.
The bidding deadline for the notes is 1300 EST/1800 GMT and results are expected around 1345 EST/1845 GMT.
(( John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1663 ))
